## FAQ
### Where is A1 Truck & Auto Sales?
1400 N 9th St #10, Modesto, CA 95350. Call ahead and we'll have the truck you want to see ready.

### What kinds of trucks do you sell?
Used commercial trucks: dump trucks, box trucks, service and utility trucks, flatbeds, rollbacks and tow trucks, and work pickups.

### Do you offer financing?
Yes. You can pre-qualify online in about two minutes, and it won't affect your credit. We call you to go over options.

### How do I know if a truck is still available?
Every truck listed on the website is available. Call (209) 857-0195 to confirm and set up a time to see it.

### What are your hours?
Hours vary, so please call ahead at (209) 857-0195 and we'll have the truck ready when you arrive.
